overview: Echo Chambers is a first-person sequence-memory fixture with four resonance monoliths and an altar. Learn the cardinal ordering and strike the monoliths without breaking the sequence. A wrong input resets progress while allowing another attempt.
rules: Activate the monoliths in North, South, East, West order.
A wrong monolith resets sequence progress and re-arms earlier monoliths.
The altar does nothing before the correct four-step sequence unseals it.
Interact with the unsealed altar to complete the game.
controls: WASD/arrows move; mouse looks; Shift sprints; Space jumps; Ctrl crouches.
Approach and aim at an enabled control, then press E to interact.
Escape opens the native menu; F5/F9 quick-save/load in the stock client.
story: The harmonic sanctum is the documented setting; no narrative campaign or named character cast is established.
characters_note: No named story characters are documented. The objects, markers and hazards shown here serve the game rules.
